# Transformers Mission 02: Multi-Head Attention
#
# Instead of one attention function, transformers use multiple
# "heads" that each learn different attention patterns.
# This is like having multiple experts looking at the input
# from different perspectives.
#
# Your goal: Implement multi_head_attention(x, W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, num_heads)
#   1. Project x into Q, K, V using weight matrices
#   2. Split each into num_heads (reshape)
#   3. Apply scaled_dot_product_attention to each head
#   4. Concatenate all heads back together
#   5. Apply output projection W_o
#
# Hint: Use the scaled_dot_product_attention from Mission 01.

import numpy as np

def scaled_dot_product_attention(Q, K, V, mask=None):
    d_k = K.shape[-1]
    scores = np.matmul(Q, K.T) / np.sqrt(d_k)
    if mask is not None:
        scores = scores + mask * -1e9
    e_x = np.exp(scores - np.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    attn = e_x / np.sum(e_x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return np.matmul(attn, V)
